text:
mia: Thinking we need a bias-sensitive attenuation policy for canaries. Problem: new quant model (v2q4) shows small overall lift but specific sensitive cohorts (e.g., cardholder, job-applicant) have higher FPR and semantic drift. Proposal: fractional traffic attenuation per-cohort using a weighted metric (KL + FPR delta). Want quick sanity-check before I open a PR.

omar: +1 on the idea. Curious about thresholds and how we compute attenuation.

eval-bot: Automated run (2026-03-21T02:12Z) comparing new-model-v2q4 -> baseline-v2: overall MRR delta -0.012, p95 latency +14ms. Per-cohort highlights:
```
cohort        | pct_traffic | FPR_delta | KL_divergence
cardholder    | 4.1%        | +0.031    | 0.072
job_applicant | 1.2%        | +0.015    | 0.038
general       | 94.7%       | -0.002    | 0.008
```
Notes: cardholder KL (0.072) > KL_threshold 0.05 and FPR_delta > 0.02.

jen: Product POV: if cardholder is 4% of traffic, we need automated mitigation but minimize customer-visible rollbacks. Attenuation (reduce traffic for that cohort) seems good. Also need a hard autoprollback if harm persists.

liam: Suggest harm_score per cohort = max(FPR_delta, KL_scaled) where KL_scaled = KL / KL_threshold, then cohort_impact = pct_traffic * harm_score. Global_harm = sum(cohort_impact). Autoswitch to baseline if Global_harm > 0.03 for 30m sliding window. For attenuation, scale cohort traffic by factor = clamp(1 - (KL - KL_threshold) * alpha, 0.5, 1.0) where alpha tuned to make 0.072 -> ~0.5.

mia: Nice. Concretely my draft rules:
- KL_threshold = 0.05, FPR_threshold = 0.02
- KL and FPR both trigger attenuation; use the larger signal.
- attenuation_factor = max(0.5, 1 - ((signal - threshold) / threshold) * 0.6)
- autopfallback: if Global_harm > 0.03 for 30m -> total rollback to baseline and open incident.
- Require min_samples_per_cohort = 250 requests in window to act.

sre-bot: Proposed policy snippet (declarative) deployed to staging: 
```yaml
canary_policy_version: "mia-v1"
canary_window: 30m
min_samples_per_cohort: 250
cohort_metrics: ["FPR", "KL"]
thresholds:
  KL: 0.05
  FPR: 0.02
attenuation:
  method: proportional_by_signal
  min_factor: 0.5
  scale_coef: 0.6
autofallback:
  global_harm_threshold: 0.03
  evaluation_window: 30m
  action: roll_to_baseline
  notify: "#oncall, @product"
cooldown: 15m
```

jen: Also ensure samples for the sensitive cohorts are redacted and stored in KMS-backed bucket. Product needs example repros for legal review.

omar: Quick perf note: v2q4 p95 latency +14ms but CPU/GPU util stable. If we attenuate traffic per cohort, routing changes must preserve session affinity. Otherwise we might amplify tail.

liam: Add deterministic shadow-sample seed + stable sampling fraction so eval runs are reproducible between model versions.

mia: Will add to PR checklist: include (1) cohort sampling seed, (2) S3 path for redacted samples, (3) automated alerting playbook. @omar @liam can you review the PR tomorrow?

omar: I can review after stand.

liam: I'll take the observability and sampling bits.

mia: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll open the PR and link the run artifacts.

eval-bot: Added run artifacts -> s3://redwood-evals/4949494949/v2q4_vs_v2/ (redacted).

sre-bot: Staging policy deployed to staging/eng-ml/canary-policies/mia-v1. Monitor for 1h before promoting to prod.
